faq.question: What usually works best at checkout: a card or a sticker?
faq.answer: It depends on whether staff can reliably hand over a card and whether the customer has enough time and free attention to tap or scan during payment.

faq.question: What should be tested first at a checkout counter?
faq.answer: The best first test measures customer response, payment-speed impact, staff prompting comfort and whether the phone interaction actually fits the counter workflow.
